title: User Sign-Up Success
description: Verify that a new user can successfully sign up with valid credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the sign-up page.
Input valid user details including email and password.
Submit the sign-up form.
User account is created, user is authenticated, and redirected to dashboard.

title: User Sign-In Success
description: Validate that a registered user can log in with correct credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the sign-in page.
Enter valid registered email and password.
Click the sign-in button.
User is authenticated and redirected to the main dashboard.

title: User Sign-In Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Ensure system denies access when signing in with invalid credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the sign-in page.
Enter incorrect email or password.
Click sign-in button.
User receives an error message and is not authenticated.

title: Create New Subject Success
description: Verify that an authenticated user can create a new subject with valid inputs.

steps.description: Login and navigate to the subject management page.
Input subject name and select a color.
Submit the subject creation form.
New subject appears in the subject list with correct color coding.

title: Prevent Subject Creation with Empty Name
description: Confirm that subject creation with an empty name is blocked with an error.

steps.description: Navigate to subject creation form.
Leave subject name empty and select a color.
Submit the form.
Error message displayed indicating that subject name is required.

title: Upload PDF Notes Successfully
description: Verify that users can upload PDF notes, and the content is parsed and chunked properly.

steps.description: Navigate to the notes upload page.
Select a valid PDF file and upload.
PDF is parsed, text chunks are generated, embeddings created, and stored successfully.
User is notified of successful upload.

title: Upload Rejection for Non-PDF Files
description: Ensure the system rejects uploading non-PDF files with appropriate error.

steps.description: Navigate to the notes upload page.
Attempt to upload a file that is not PDF format.
Upload is blocked, and error message indicates invalid file type.

title: Disable Exam Generation for Subjects Without Notes
description: Verify that exam generation option is disabled and proper error is shown if no notes uploaded for the subject.

steps.description: Select a subject known to have no uploaded notes.
Exam generation button is disabled.
User is shown error message stating no notes available for exam generation.

title: Generate Exam Successfully
description: Validate AI-powered exam generation from notes succeeds with correct parameters and meets performance criteria.

steps.description: Select a subject with existing notes.
Configure exam parameters: number of questions and difficulty.
Start exam generation.
Exam is generated successfully within 30 seconds, containing requested number and difficulty of questions.

title: Handle Exam Generation Failure Gracefully
description: Ensure system shows error notification if exam generation fails or exceeds time limits.

steps.description: Trigger exam generation but simulate AI or vector search failure or timeout.
System notifies user with a clear error message about generation failure.
User can retry exam generation without application crash.

title: Load Exam for Taking Within Performance Limits
description: Verify that loading an exam for taking completes within 2 seconds.

steps.description: Navigate to an existing exam's take page.
Exam data including questions load and render within 2 seconds.

title: Take Exam with Real-Time Progress Tracking
description: Ensure real-time progress updates while answering questions and submitting answers.

steps.description: Start taking a loaded exam.
Answer questions one by one, observe progress updates.
Progress bar or indicator updates immediately with each answered question.

title: Answer Submission and Scoring Response Time
description: Verify that answer submission and scoring responses complete within 1 second.

steps.description: Submit an answer for a question.
System returns scoring feedback and updates state within 1 second.

title: Handle Empty or Missing Answers Gracefully
description: Confirm the system allows exam to proceed if user skips or leaves answers empty without affecting score calculation incorrectly.

steps.description: Skip answering a question and proceed to next.
Complete exam with one or more unanswered questions.
System records unanswered questions as empty, does not count towards positive or negative score undesirably.

title: Prevent Duplicate Exam Submissions
description: Verify the UI disables multiple submissions of the same exam to prevent duplicate entries.

steps.description: Submit an exam answer or final exam submission.
Submit button or UI controls become disabled or loading state to prevent duplicate submission.

title: View Completed Exam Results with Detailed Feedback
description: Check that users can open completed exams and see score, answer correctness, and explanation for each question.

steps.description: Navigate to completed exams list.
Select a completed exam to view details.
Display detailed score, individual question correctness, and explanations.

title: Exam List Filtering by Subject
description: Verify filtering functionality in the exam list page by selecting different subjects.

steps.description: Navigate to exams list page.
Select a subject filter from dropdown or filters.
Exam list updates and shows only exams related to selected subject.

title: Delete Exam Entry
description: Ensure user can delete an exam from exam management UI and exam is removed permanently.

steps.description: Navigate to exams list.
Select an exam and initiate delete action.
Confirm deletion prompt, upon confirmation exam is removed from database and list.

title: Database Integrity on Exam, Question, and Answer Creation
description: Check database records are correctly created and linked when generating exams, questions, and user answers.

steps.description: Generate an exam with questions.
Answer some questions and submit.
Database entries exist for exams, questions, answers, and performance tracking with proper foreign keys.

title: System Uptime and Availability Monitoring
description: Verify through monitoring tools and logs that system uptime exceeds 99%.

steps.description: Monitor system uptime over continuous period using health check endpoints.
System uptime reports show availability is above 99%.
